title: SaveRelay game
description: One game SaveRelay can find on its own. The file name (lowercase, dashes) is the game's id. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

name.description: The game's name as players know it.

saves.description: Where save folders are. Starts with {documents}, {savedgames}, {appdata}, {localappdata}, {localappdatalow} or {home}; * matches one folder level.

contains.description: A save folder directly contains at least one file matching this, e.g. *.sav.

exe.description: Program names shown in Task Manager's Details tab while the game runs.

include.description: Files to sync, relative to the save folder.

exclude.description: Files never to sync, e.g. per-player settings.

stripPrefix.description: Removed from folder names when shown, e.g. MP-.

example.description: Sample files and the save names SaveRelay should find among them. The tests create them and check.
